confidence_definitions.visually_inspected: Actual example pages viewed (not full corpus verified)
confidence_definitions.pdf_text_checked: Source text sampled; visual diagrams require further original-image verification
confidence_definitions.topic_inventory_text_checked: Topic taxonomy read, not question examples
confidence_definitions.folder_inventory_only: Source file names and paths verified but question text not examined

release_criteria: Use exact CPM course/chapter/lesson and Assessment Plan learning goal before drafting any student item.
Review canonical family contracts before creating new family IDs; add evidence modes / constraints rather than labels-only variants.
Build difficulty by dependency and knowledge, not coefficient size or arbitrary denominators.
New Question varies mathematical evidence axes; changing names, ordering, font or numbers alone is not evidence diversification.
Keep original textbook Review & Preview separately sourced; never substitute an outside problem and present it as an original CPM R/P.
Do not transfer copyrighted source problem sentences, numerical data, diagrams, choices or answer keys into generators.
All generated answers independently checked with symbolic/numeric validators and visual models checked against source specifications.
Use canonical graph tool for Cartesian graphs; blank student graph should not reveal solution.
No mandatory mixed numbers if course bank current display standard is improper fractions; no coefficient 1 or exponent 1 where unnecessary.
Keep Good/Needs Work/Bad review controls, preserve legacy feedback backup, never autoapprove draft families.
Question family has genuine semantic evidence; count is based on coverage, never quotas or 12 fixed variants.
Extensions require transfer, generalization, alternative strategy or proof, not simply larger numbers.
